top.name: Spell Prism
top.rules_text: Raise a Prism within 4 (HP 8). A single-target spell you cast at an enemy within 2 of it also hits the nearest other enemy within 2 of it.

bottom.name: Charged Conduit
bottom.rules_text: Draw a casting circle on a tile within 4. The next spell you cast while standing on it gains +2 damage per Charge you have, then consumes all your Charge.

upgrades.description: Prism is sturdier and reaches further. Conduit converts harder.

changes.value: Raise a Prism within 4 (HP 12). A single-target spell you cast at an enemy within 3 of it also hits the nearest other enemy within 3 of it.
Draw a casting circle on a tile within 4. The next spell you cast while standing on it gains +3 damage per Charge you have, then consumes all your Charge.
Raise a Prism within 4 (HP 12). A single-target spell you cast at an enemy within 3 of it also hits the 2 nearest other enemies within 3 of it.
Draw a casting circle on a tile within 4. The next spell you cast while standing on it gains +3 damage per Charge you have, then consumes half your Charge (rounded up).
Raise a Prism within 4 (HP 14). A single-target spell you cast at an enemy within 3 of it also hits the 3 nearest other enemies within 3 of it.
Draw a casting circle on a tile within 4. The next spell you cast while standing on it gains +3 damage per Charge you have, then consumes half your Charge (rounded up), then gives back half of that.
Raise a Prism within 4 (HP 20). A single-target spell you cast at an enemy within 3 of it also hits every other enemy within 3 of it.
Draw a casting circle on a tile within 4. The next spell you cast while standing on it gains +4 damage per Charge you have, then consumes half your Charge (rounded up), then gives all of it back.
